newsitem.title: SPAIN: GOLF-BALLESTEROS SACKS FOURTH CADDIE IN TWO YEARS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BALLESTEROS SACKS FOURTH CADDIE IN TWO YEARS.

text.p: Ryder Cup captain Seve Ballesteros sacked his fourth caddie in two years on Friday after a disagreement at the sixth hole during the second round of the Spanish Open.
The fiery Spaniard has installed one of his nephews to caddie at the weekend after the fall-out with his bag carrier, Englishman Martin Gray.
"It seemed to me my caddie didn't have much energy out on the course," said Ballesteros, who has been battling a form slump this season. "We had a little disagreement on the sixth and he has gone."
Ballesteros looked set to make his first cut from seven starts this year after firing a 73 in the second round. He was at one-under, with the cut-off unlikely to be lower than level-par.
He trailed early second round leader Mark James of England by eight strokes.
